improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value proposition and free trial offer. Open Graph and Twitter Card tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Facebook, or Twitter—critical channels for reaching business professionals. Including the free searches offer creates urgency and reduces friction for new visitors.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace built for business owners and traders. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clearly states what it is, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights the three core value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while targeting the specific audience. Ending with the free trial offer and 'no card required' removes friction and encourages immediate action. Copy remains factual and aligned with provided site context.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member to continue. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's trade and business intelligence, voice chat, and your own dedicated workspace. Choose monthly flexibility or save 30 percent with an annual plan.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens when the free trial ends. It reassures visitors there's no hidden cost, transparently states pricing from the site context, and highlights key member benefits to encourage conversion at the paywall moment.
